# Page spec reference (`page.spec.yaml` v1)

Every PaperOS page is a file `specs/pages/<id>.spec.yaml` validated by `@paperos/spec`
(`parseSpec`, `validatePageSpec`) against `PageSpecSchema` (Zod 4). The JSON Schema for editors is
[`packages/spec/schema/page.spec.schema.json`](../../packages/spec/schema/page.spec.schema.json);
the first line of every spec points at it:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=../../packages/spec/schema/page.spec.schema.json
```

Decision record: [ADR 0015](../adr/0015-page-spec-schema.md). Examples: [`specs/pages/`](../../specs/pages/).

## Rules the schema cannot say on its own

* `meta.id` equals the file name stem (`customer-invoices.spec.yaml` → `customer-invoices`).
* `meta.specVersion` missing is read as `1` with `SPEC_VERSION_MISSING`; any other value is `SPEC_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION`.
* Unknown top-level keys are errors unless prefixed `x-` (`x-*` passes through untouched). The v1.1 keys
  `flags`, `modules`, `comments`, `help`, `seo`, `budgets` parse as unknown with `SPEC_RESERVED_KEY` (PAP-740).
* Nested unknown keys are errors everywhere; the hint names the closest allowed key.
* Every `components[].events` value, `states.*.action`, `edgeCases[].action`, `access.actions` key and
  action-sourced `events[].on` must be a key under `logic.actions` (`SPEC_ACTION_UNBOUND`).
* `components[].key` and `edgeCases[].id` are page-unique; duplicates list both lines.
* `events[].to` is a `$param` route, or an http(s) URL when `kind: external`.
* User-visible text (`meta.title`, `states.*.copy`, `logic.actions.*.intent`, notification copy) is a message
  catalog key or `{ id, default }`, never a literal sentence (`SPEC_LITERAL_COPY`). Keys are
  `<specId>.<path>`; the English text lives in `default` and seeds the catalog (PAP-375).
* YAML anchors and merge keys are resolved before validation; positions point at the merged document.
* Duplicate YAML keys are errors (`SPEC_DUP_KEY`) with both lines; BOM and CRLF are normalised.
* Specs over 200 KB warn (`SPEC_TOO_LARGE`).

### `status: ready` gate

A page may move from `draft` to `ready` only when all of these hold (`SPEC_READY_INCOMPLETE` otherwise):

1. `access` is present.
2. `data` is present, or the page is marked `x-static: true`.
3. At least three `edgeCases`.
4. Every `events[].to` resolves to a declared route (checked when the validator is given `knownRoutes`; PAP-115 supplies them).

Warnings on a `ready` page: a missing standard state (`SPEC_READY_STATES`: `error` and `denied` always, `loading`
and `empty` with `data`, `offline` with `live` or `local` queries). A `built` page with `not-wired` components or
actions warns `SPEC_BUILT_NOT_WIRED`.

### Actions registry, placeholders and languages

* `logic.actions` is the page's actions registry: each entry has an `intent` phrase (message key, so it exists in
  English and Spanish), a `permission` and `steps`. `pageActions(spec)` flattens it for the WebMCP surface and the
  voice controller; component `events` bind to these ids.
* `status: not-wired` on a component or action marks a placeholder: dev mode shows it and activation shows the
  "not wired yet" toast. `notWiredComponents(spec)` lists them.

## Sections

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `meta` | [Meta](#meta) | yes | Identity of the page. |
| `purpose` | [Purpose](#purpose) | yes | Why the page exists. |
| `logic` | [LogicSection](#logicsection) | no | Actions registry of the page. Default `{"actions":{}}`. |
| `access` | [AccessSection](#accesssection) | no | Required for `status: ready`. |
| `data` | [DataSection](#datasection) | no | Required for `status: ready` unless `x-static: true`. |
| `integrations` | [IntegrationsSection](#integrationssection) | no | External connectors (interim; final shape PAP-121). Default `[]`. |
| `layout` | [Layout](#layout) | yes | Template and slots. |
| `components` | [ComponentsSection](#componentssection) | no | Component tree of the page. Default `[]`. |
| `states` | [StatesSection](#statessection) | no | Page states: the five standard ones plus custom states, each `{ copy, component?, action? }`. Default `{}`. |
| `events` | [Transition](#transition)[] | no | Navigation transitions. Default `[]`. |
| `edgeCases` | [EdgeCase](#edgecase)[] | no | At least three for `status: ready`. Default `[]`. |
| `flags` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |
| `modules` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |
| `comments` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |
| `help` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |
| `seo` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |
| `budgets` | unknown | no | Reserved for v1.1 (PAP-740). |

## Types

Named shapes referenced above (`$defs` in the JSON Schema).

### AccessAction

Who may run one `logic.actions` entry.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `audiences` | [AudienceId](#audienceid)[] | yes | Audiences allowed to run the action. |
| `condition` | [FilterTree](#filtertree) | no | Row or attribute condition that must hold, `{ $var: "principal.id" }` allowed. |

### AccessSection

Who can see the page and run its actions (interim; final shape PAP-116).

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `public` | boolean | no | `true` grants the `anonymous` audience `page.view`; conflicts with `principal.*` refs. Default `false`. |
| `view` | [AudienceId](#audienceid)[] | no | Audiences granted `page.view`. Default `[]`. |
| `actions` | record<[ActionRef](#actionref), [AccessAction](#accessaction)> | no | Per-action grants; keys must exist under `logic.actions`. Default `{}`. |
| `rows` | record<[EntityId](#entityid), [FilterTree](#filtertree)> | no | Row predicates per entity, merged into every query (PAP-119) and enforced server-side. Default `{}`. |
| `deny` | [AudienceId](#audienceid)[] | no | Audiences denied everything on this page; beats every grant. Default `[]`. |
| `fields` | record<string, object> | no | Field-level visibility, `entity.field` → audiences. Default `{}`. |
| `inherit` | boolean | no | Merge `app.spec.yaml` `defaults.access`; `false` starts from nothing. Default `true`. |

### Action

One registered page action.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `intent` | [MessageRef](#messageref) | yes | Intent phrase for the voice controller and WebMCP, as a message key (`customer-invoices.actions.pay.intent`). |
| `permission` | [PermissionRef](#permissionref) | yes | Permission required to run the action. |
| `description` | string | no | Author-facing note, not rendered. |
| `steps` | string[] | yes | What happens, in order, as prose. |
| `guard` | string | no | Precondition as prose or an expression (PAP-314 compiles it). |
| `effects` | [Effect](#effect)[] | no | Side effects. Default `[]`. |
| `onError` | [OnError](#onerror) | no | Failure handling for one action. |
| `input` | record<[ActionRef](#actionref), [ScalarType](#scalartype)> | no | Parameters the action takes, for the WebMCP tool signature. Default `{}`. |
| `status` | [WiredStatus](#wiredstatus) | no | `not-wired` while the logic is a stub. Default `"wired"`. |

### ActionRef

Key of an entry under `logic.actions` on the same page.

```regex
^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$
```

### AudienceId

Audience id from `app.spec.yaml` (PAP-117) / the audience model (PAP-55).

```regex
^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$
```

### CamelId

camelCase identifier: `payInvoice`.

```regex
^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$
```

### Component

One node of the component tree.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `id` | [ComponentRef](#componentref) | yes | Registered component id. |
| `key` | [CamelId](#camelid) | yes | Page-unique key; codegen, tours and comments anchor on it. |
| `props` | record<string, unknown> | no | Props as JSON; text-bearing props take a `MessageRef`. Validated against the registry by PAP-115. Default `{}`. |
| `slot` | [SlotName](#slotname) | no | Layout slot the component renders in. Default `"main"`. |
| `events` | record<[EventName](#eventname), [ActionRef](#actionref)> | no | Component event → action id under `logic.actions`. Default `{}`. |
| `status` | [WiredStatus](#wiredstatus) | no | `not-wired` marks a placeholder. Default `"wired"`. |
| `children` | [Component](#component)[] | no | Nested components. Default `[]`. |

### ComponentRef

Design-system component id registered by PAP-74: `ui.dataTable`, `app.invoiceCard`, `print.header`.

```regex
^(?:ui|app|print)\.[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$
```

### ComponentsSection

Component tree of the page.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `[]` | [Component](#component) | no |  |

Reads and writes the page performs (interim; final shape PAP-119 / PAP-311).

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `entities` | [EntityId](#entityid)[] | no | Entities this page touches (cross-checked by PAP-115). Default `[]`. |
| `queries` | record<[CamelId](#camelid), [Query](#query)> | no | Named reads; each becomes a `use<Name>()` hook. Default `{}`. |
| `mutations` | record<[CamelId](#camelid), [Mutation](#mutation)> | no | Named writes; each becomes a `use<Name>()` mutation hook. Default `{}`. |

### EdgeCase

One edge case the page handles.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `id` | [KebabId](#kebabid) | yes | Stable id, unique on the page. |
| `scenario` | string | yes | What happens. |

### Effect

Side effect of an action: prose, or `{ kind, ref?, copy? }` when it should show on the flow graph.

### EntityId

Entity id from `app.spec.yaml` (PAP-117).

```regex
^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$
```

### EventName

Component event as registered by PAP-74: `onClick`.

```regex
^on[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$
```

### EventSource

What fires a transition: an action id, `componentKey.onEvent`, `page.load` or `page.leave`.

```regex
^(?:[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(?:\.on[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)?|page\.(?:load|leave))$
```

### ExternalUrl

http(s) URL for `events[].kind: external`.

```regex
^https?:\/\/[^\s]+$
```

### FieldPath

Field path inside an entity: `status`, `customer.email`.

```regex
^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*(?:\.[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)*$
```

### FilterCondition

Leaf condition of a `FilterTree`.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `field` | string | yes | Field path on the entity, dotted for relations. |
| `operator` | `eq` \| `neq` \| `in` \| `nin` \| `lt` \| `lte` \| `gt` \| `gte` \| `contains` \| `startsWith` \| `isNull` \| `isNotNull` \| `between` \| `has` \| `matches` | yes | Comparison operator (PAP-279 grammar). |
| `value` | unknown | no | Literal value, or `{ $var: "principal.id" }` bound at evaluation time. |

### FilterTree

Shared filter grammar (`@paperos/core/filter`, PAP-279): a group `{ op, children }` or a condition `{ field, operator, value }`.

### Integration

One external connector the page depends on.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `connector` | [KebabId](#kebabid) | yes | Connector id from the registry: `stripe`, `linear`, `resend`. |
| `capabilities` | string[] | yes | Capability ids used, `<area>.<verbNoun>`. |
| `mode` | `live` \| `test` \| `mock` | no | A page may only narrow the app-level mode (`live` app allows `test` page, not the reverse). Default `"mock"`. |
| `onFailure` | `degrade` \| `block` \| `queue` | no | `degrade` renders `ui.integrationUnavailable`; `block` shows the error state; `queue` defers. Default `"degrade"`. |

### IntegrationsSection

External connectors (interim; final shape PAP-121).

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `[]` | [Integration](#integration) | no |  |

### KebabId

Kebab-case identifier: `customer-invoices`.

```regex
^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$
```

### Layout

Template and slots.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `template` | `app` \| `public` \| `focus` \| `kiosk` | yes | `app` shell with nav; `public` marketing chrome; `focus` single task; `kiosk` full-screen, 10-foot type. |
| `slots` | record<[SlotName](#slotname), [SlotSpec](#slotspec)> | no | Slots the page fills and their options; components target them with `slot`. Default `{}`. |
| `density` | `compact` \| `default` \| `comfortable` | no | Default density; `kiosk` templates should use `comfortable`. Default `"default"`. |

### LogicSection

Actions registry of the page.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `actions` | record<[ActionRef](#actionref), [Action](#action)> | no | Actions keyed by camelCase id. Default `{}`. |

### MessageKey

Message catalog key (`<specId>.<path>`) resolved in every locale; never a literal sentence.

```regex
^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*)+$
```

### MessageRef

User-visible text as a message key, or `{ id, default }` where `default` seeds the English catalog (PAP-375).

### Meta

Identity of the page.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `id` | [KebabId](#kebabid) | yes | Page id; equals the file name stem of `specs/pages/<id>.spec.yaml`. |
| `title` | [MessageRef](#messageref) | yes | Page title as a message key. |
| `description` | string | no | Author-facing summary, not rendered. |
| `route` | [RouteRef](#routeref) | yes | Route the page mounts at. |
| `surface` | [Surface](#surface) | yes | Who the page is for; picks the default layout, audiences and shell. |
| `owner` | [KebabId](#kebabid) | yes | Owning project or character (`spec-builder`, `quill`). |
| `status` | [SpecStatus](#specstatus) | no | `draft` → `ready` (gate rules apply) → `built` → `deprecated`. Default `"draft"`. |
| `specVersion` | `1` | no | Schema version; missing is read as 1 with a warning. Default `1`. |
| `tags` | [KebabId](#kebabid)[] | no | Free tags for the spec list and graph filters. Default `[]`. |

### Mutation

One write the page performs.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `entity` | [EntityId](#entityid) | yes | Entity the mutation writes. |
| `action` | `create` \| `update` \| `delete` \| `custom` | yes | Kind of write. |

### OnError

Failure handling for one action.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `strategy` | `toast` \| `inline` \| `retry` \| `redirect` \| `ignore` | yes | How the failure surfaces. |
| `copy` | [MessageRef](#messageref) | no | Copy shown for `toast` and `inline`. |
| `to` | [RouteRef](#routeref) | no | Destination for `redirect`. |

### PermissionRef

Permission the caller needs: `public`, `page.view`, `invoice.pay`.

```regex
^(?:public|[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)+)$
```

### Purpose

Why the page exists.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `summary` | string | yes | One paragraph: who uses the page and what they get done. |
| `successMetric` | string | no | How we know the page works (a measurable outcome). |

### Query

One read the page performs.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `entity` | [EntityId](#entityid) | yes | Entity the query reads. |
| `filter` | [FilterTree](#filtertree) | no | Filter merged with the `access.rows` predicate. |
| `sort` | object[] | no | Sort order. Default `[]`. |
| `fields` | [FieldPath](#fieldpath)[] | no | Fields selected; all when omitted. |
| `sync` | `server` \| `live` \| `local` | no | `server` TanStack Query; `live` / `local` Electric shape with the offline outbox (PAP-36). Default `"server"`. |
| `page` | integer | no | Page size, at most 100 (Contracts §4). Default `50`. |

### RouteRef

Absolute TanStack route with `$param` segments: `/invoices/$invoiceId`. `:param` is rejected.

```regex
^\/$|^\/(?:[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*|\$[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*)(?:\/(?:[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*|\$[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*))*\/?$
```

### ScalarType

Mutation input scalar (interim; PAP-742 adds constraints).

One of: `string`, `text`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`, `dateTime`, `money`, `uuid`, `json`.

### SlotName

Layout slot: the six app-shell slots of PAP-16 plus `header` and `footer` for public and kiosk templates.

One of: `nav`, `sidebar`, `main`, `inspector`, `commandbar`, `statusbar`, `header`, `footer`.

### SlotSpec

Options for one layout slot the page fills.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `title` | [MessageRef](#messageref) | no | Slot heading when the shell shows one. |
| `collapsible` | boolean | no | Default `false`. |
| `defaultCollapsed` | boolean | no | Default `false`. |

### SpecStatus

`draft` → `ready` (gate rules apply) → `built` → `deprecated`.

One of: `draft`, `ready`, `built`, `deprecated`.

### State

One page state.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `copy` | [MessageRef](#messageref) | yes | Copy shown in this state, as a message key. |
| `component` | [ComponentRef](#componentref) | no | Component that renders the state (`ui.errorState`, `ui.offlineBanner`, `ui.deniedState`, PAP-234). |
| `action` | [ActionRef](#actionref) | no | Call to action, an id under `logic.actions` (retry, create first item). |

### StatesSection

Page states: the five standard ones plus custom states, each `{ copy, component?, action? }`.

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `loading` | [State](#state) | no | One page state. |
| `empty` | [State](#state) | no | One page state. |
| `error` | [State](#state) | no | One page state. |
| `offline` | [State](#state) | no | One page state. |
| `denied` | [State](#state) | no | One page state. |

### Surface

Who the page is for; picks the default layout, audiences and shell.

One of: `customer`, `staff`, `developer`, `agent`, `public`.

### Transition

A navigation edge on the flow graph (PAP-123).

| Path | Type | Required | Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `on` | [EventSource](#eventsource) | yes | What fires the transition. |
| `to` | [RouteRef](#routeref) \| [ExternalUrl](#externalurl) | yes | Destination route (`$param` syntax) or, with `kind: external`, an http(s) URL. |
| `guard` | string | no | Condition, as prose or an expression. |
| `kind` | `navigate` \| `replace` \| `modal` \| `external` | no | `navigate` push, `replace`, `modal` overlay, `external` new tab. Default `"navigate"`. |

### WiredStatus

`not-wired` marks a placeholder: dev mode shows it, activation shows the "not wired yet" toast.

One of: `wired`, `not-wired`.

## Issue codes

Every issue `parseSpec` / `validatePageSpec` can raise. `hint` says what to do.

| Code | Severity | Meaning |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `SPEC_PARSE` | error | The document is not valid YAML. |
| `SPEC_NOT_OBJECT` | error | The document root is not a mapping. |
| `SPEC_DUP_KEY` | error | A mapping declares the same key twice; both lines are listed. |
| `SPEC_TOO_LARGE` | warning | The spec is over 200 KB; split sub-flows into their own pages. |
| `SPEC_SCHEMA_HEADER` | warning | The first line does not point editors at the JSON Schema. |
| `SPEC_VERSION_MISSING` | warning | `meta.specVersion` is missing; the spec is read as version 1. |
| `SPEC_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION` | error | `meta.specVersion` is not a version this package understands. |
| `SPEC_UNKNOWN_KEY` | error | A key the schema does not know; top-level extensions must be prefixed `x-`. |
| `SPEC_RESERVED_KEY` | warning | A v1.1 key (`flags`, `modules`, `comments`, `help`, `seo`, `budgets`) is present and not validated yet (PAP-740). |
| `SPEC_TYPE` | error | A value has the wrong type or a required key is missing. |
| `SPEC_ENUM` | error | A value is not one of the allowed options. |
| `SPEC_FORMAT` | error | A string does not match its grammar. |
| `SPEC_RANGE` | error | A value or list is outside its allowed size. |
| `SPEC_BAD_KEY` | error | A record key does not match its grammar. |
| `SPEC_BAD_ROUTE` | error | A route is not TanStack `$param` syntax. |
| `SPEC_BAD_COMPONENT_REF` | error | A component id is not `ui.<name>`, `app.<name>` or `print.<name>`. |
| `SPEC_LITERAL_COPY` | error | User-visible text is a literal string instead of a message catalog key. |
| `SPEC_BAD_PERMISSION` | error | A permission is not `public` or dotted. |
| `SPEC_ID_FILENAME` | error | `meta.id` does not equal the file name stem. |
| `SPEC_DUP_COMPONENT_KEY` | error | Two components share a `key`; both lines are listed. |
| `SPEC_DUP_EDGE_ID` | error | Two edge cases share an `id`. |
| `SPEC_ACTION_UNBOUND` | error | A reference names an action that is not declared under `logic.actions`. |
| `SPEC_EVENT_SOURCE` | error | `events[].on` names a component key or event that does not exist. |
| `SPEC_EVENT_KIND` | error | `events[].to` is a URL without `kind: external`, or `kind: external` without a URL. |
| `SPEC_SLOT_UNDECLARED` | warning | A component targets a slot `layout.slots` does not list. |
| `SPEC_ROUTE_UNRESOLVED` | error | `events[].to` is not a known route (checked when `knownRoutes` is supplied; error for `ready`, warning otherwise). |
| `SPEC_READY_INCOMPLETE` | error | `status: ready` without `access`, without `data` or `x-static: true`, with fewer than three edge cases, or with an unresolvable transition. |
| `SPEC_READY_STATES` | warning | A `ready` page lacks a standard state (`error`, `denied`; `loading`, `empty` with data; `offline` with live data). |
| `SPEC_BUILT_NOT_WIRED` | warning | A `built` page still has `status: not-wired` components or actions. |
